## Episode Thesis

This is a non-investment episode that looks back at the 1997 Trustor scandal. Journalist Gunnar Lindstedt, who exposed the scandal, criticises the new Netflix documentary for giving Joachim Posener a platform without challenge and for glorifying the fraud. The hosts briefly discuss the large discounts investment companies traded at compared with their net asset value in the 1990s, and how dual-class A/B shares let financial families control companies; no directional market view is given.
